# RMe Series RM750e Fully Modular Low-Noise ATX Power Supply (EU)

CORSAIR RMe Series Fully Modular Low-Noise Power Supplies include a dedicated 12V-2x6 GPU power cable, ATX 3.1 certification and PCIe 5.1 compliance, and Cybenetics™ Gold rated efficiency for a quiet, reliable build. The RMe PSUs' compact size also allow for easier cable management.

Includes

- Fully-Modular design for cleaner wiring
- Native 600W-capable 12V-2x6 cable for high-end GPUs
- Cybenetics Gold-certified efficiency
- Ultra-flexible embossed cables with low-profile combs
- Compact size for improved cable management
- Intel ATX 3.1 Certified, PCIe 5.1 compatible

## RMe SERIES

FULLY MODULAR LOW-NOISE ATX PSUs



BUILD WITH THE BEST

## 50 SERIES GPUs ARE HERE

Pair a next-gen GPU with quality CORSAIR components for top-shelf performance and no hassles, right out of the box.

[LEARN MORE](https://www.corsair.com/eu/en/s/nvidia-50-series-pc-builds)



KEEP IT NEAT AND TIDY

## FULLY MODULAR CABLING

Keep cable clutter down by connecting only the cables your system needs. A native 600W 12V-2x6 GPU connector and multiple 8-pin PCIe connectors mean RMe power supplies more than meet the needs of modern and upcoming GPUs and CPUs.



ON THE CUTTING-EDGE

## ATX 3.1 CERTIFIED

The ATX 3.1 standard demands a high level of reliability and power efficiency. While many CORSAIR PSUs meet these requirements, RMe Series PSUs are formally certified for ATX 3.1 compliance.

PCIe 5.1 12V-2x6 GPU cables included for use with modern and next-gen graphics cards.





## CYBENETICS GOLD CERTIFIED

Steady power output at up to 89% overall efficiency and Cybenetics™ Gold certified for lower power consumption, less noise, and cooler temperatures.



## LOW NOISE OPERATION IN A COMPACT SIZE

A compact 140mm-long casing ensures an easy fit in modern enthusiast PC cases.

A 120mm rifle bearing fan with a specially calculated fan curve keeps fan noise down, even when operating at full load.





BUILT TO LAST

## TECHNOLOGY AND RELIABILITY

For consistent, reliable power and superb electrical performance, each RMe Series power supply features a robust resonant LLC topology with DC-DC conversion and 105° rated industrial-grade capacitors.

With precise timings, RMe supports Modern Standby, ensuring extremely fast wake-from-sleep times and better low-load efficiency.



## SEVEN-YEAR WARRANTY

## WORLD-CLASS SUPPORT

Our award-winning service means you can enjoy your gear worry-free.
